about: One supported panel. Read by the firmware YAML (esphome/, !include), tokens/layout.json devices (tools/gen_layout.mjs), the docs site (install page, engine.ts), deploy.yml and the issue templates (boards/templates.mjs). status: target = a release firmware is built for it. memory: keep_pages = how many deck pages the panel keeps built (facet-243); malloc_always_internal = CONFIG_SPIRAM_MALLOC_ALWAYSINTERNAL (facet-242; absent = the chip's default).
name: Guition ESP32-S3-4848S040
